summary: Similarweb Ltd. filed a Form 6-K amending its 2026 annual general meeting materials. The filing clarifies that Mr. Harel Beit-On will step down as audit committee chair but remains a Class II director nominee, amends the Compensation Policy to tie discretionary bonuses for officers other than the CEO to measurable performance criteria, and removes a special retirement bonus provision, capping termination benefits at 24 months' base salary. This is a routine proxy update, not a special situation.
